UGA.note: Surveillance concerns about ITMS are raised by rights groups; no rule or authority on AI harms is stated.

facts.fact: The Independent reports that the state's Intelligent Transport Monitoring System, built with Joint Stock Company Global Security, combines CCTV, tracking and data analytics to identify vehicles and is described by the system itself as using AI.

UGA.note: No AI law or draft is named.
Health and farming AI tools are described but no public sector system is stated in service.

facts.fact: The Independent reports the Ministry of ICT says Uganda's National AI and Emerging Technologies Strategy is being developed, with 2026 strategy consultations across sectors.
facts.system: National AI and Emerging Technologies Strategy

facts.fact: The Independent describes IntelliFarmAI as a Ugandan-built AI-powered farmer decision-support system, in use by a farmer in Napak district.
The Independent says the Mak Ocular System, developed at Makerere University with Google.org support, uses AI object detection on blood smears to spot malaria, tuberculosis and cervical cancer.
